title: Ultra Juicy Saudi Arabian King Prawns Ceviche
description: A refreshing and flavorful Saudi Arabian dish featuring raw king prawns, perfect for a sick day, made with dairy-free friendly ingredients. This ceviche is a fatty and juicy treat that will help you feel better in no time.
instructions: Rinse the king prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
Submerge the prawns in an ice bath to shock them and stop any cooking process.
In a large bowl, mix together the lemon juice, olive oil, chopped cilantro, chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper.
Add the diced cucumber to the bowl and stir to combine.
Remove the prawns from the ice bath and add them to the bowl, making sure they are fully coated with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the ceviche a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro and scallions if desired.
